title: If the Sun Disappeared, Who'd Notice Last?
topic: The missing light of a vanished Sun travels outward as a shell of darkness: Mars after ~13 min, Jupiter ~43 min, Neptune ~4 h, Voyager 1 (one light-day away) a day later. Cut from Ep 5.

beats.narration: Twelve o'clock, noon: the Sun vanishes.
Then the whole daytime side of Earth goes dark at once.
phrases: side of Earth goes dark at

beats.narration: But the darkness doesn't stop at Earth.
About thirteen minutes after the Sun vanishes, the darkness reaches Mars. After forty-three minutes, Jupiter. After four hours, Neptune.
And a full day later, it reaches the farthest thing humans have ever built. Voyager 1 is now one light-day from Earth.
